findings.description: The session_overhead bucket was introduced to report orchestrator-session usage in GET /usage/by-phase. However, PhaseUsageRow in openapi/v1.yaml requires dispatch_id and intended_model as non-nullable string fields. Because session_overhead represents usage not associated with any phase dispatch, it has no dispatch_id or intended_model. Emitting null or omitting these fields for session_overhead violates the PhaseUsageRow schema in OpenAPI and generated types.
findings.resolution: Update PhaseUsageRow in contracts/openapi/v1.yaml (and generated types) to make dispatch_id and intended_model nullable (type: [string, null]).

findings.description: POST /usage/dispatch requestBody in openapi/v1.yaml references DispatchRecordPatch only instead of supporting initial creation (oneOf: [DispatchRecordCreate, DispatchRecordPatch]). Furthermore, DispatchRecordCreate omits dispatched_at required by contracts/events/dispatch-record.schema.json, and DispatchRecord inherits DispatchRecordPatch, omitting change_id, phase, intended_model, and session_id from its required properties.
findings.resolution: Update POST /usage/dispatch requestBody in openapi/v1.yaml to accept oneOf: [DispatchRecordCreate, DispatchRecordPatch], add dispatched_at to DispatchRecordCreate, and compose DispatchRecord from DispatchRecordCreate plus timestamps.

findings.description: All /usage/* GET routes were updated to require API keys and principal scoping in openapi/v1.yaml. However, specs/usage-accounting/spec.md (lines 202-207) and specs/agent-coordinator/spec.md (lines 29-32) still describe GET /usage/summary, GET /usage/by-phase, GET /usage/by-model, GET /usage/mismatches, and GET /usage/events as unauthenticated GET routes, contradicting openapi/v1.yaml.
findings.resolution: Update specs/usage-accounting/spec.md and specs/agent-coordinator/spec.md to state that all GET /usage/* routes require API key authentication and are principal-scoped.

findings.description: Task 4.4b in tasks.md explicitly requires modifying skills/shared/provider_dispatch.py to thread sub-agent IDs on the return path. However, wp-dispatch scope.write_allow in work-packages.yaml omits skills/shared/**, causing isolated worktrees or scope validators to reject modifications to skills/shared/provider_dispatch.py.
findings.resolution: Add "skills/shared/**" to scope.write_allow of wp-dispatch in work-packages.yaml.

findings.description: contracts/generated/models.py retains the obsolete DispatchRecordUpsert model and lacks DispatchRecordCreate and DispatchRecordPatch defined in openapi/v1.yaml. Task 1.4 requires regenerating models.py from OpenAPI, but the checked-in stub in generated/models.py is stale.
findings.resolution: Regenerate contracts/generated/models.py from openapi/v1.yaml to include DispatchRecordCreate and DispatchRecordPatch.

findings.description: contracts/db/schema.sql specifies a 30-day retention purge for usage_ingest_state cursor rows. However, specs/agent-coordinator/spec.md and Task 3.10 only specify purging transcript_events and omit the usage_ingest_state retention requirement.
findings.resolution: Add usage_ingest_state retention purge requirements to specs/agent-coordinator/spec.md and expand Task 3.10 in tasks.md.

findings.description: TokenTotals in openapi/v1.yaml mandates non-nullable pricing_version: string. In db/schema.sql, ck_usage_cost_provenance allows cost_usd and pricing_version to be NULL when unpriced. Requiring pricing_version to be a non-null string in TokenTotals causes validation failures when returning unpriced aggregate totals.
findings.resolution: Update pricing_version in TokenTotals in openapi/v1.yaml and generated types to be nullable (type: [string, null]).
